name: tracecite
description: A format and dependency-free builder for evidence-first documents with sources that open in place.

scripts.build:examples: node scripts/build-reading.mjs --data examples/outliners.trace.json --out references/outliners-reading.html --zip samples/outliners.trace.zip && node scripts/build-reading.mjs --data examples/document-structure/document-structure.trace.json --out references/document-structure-reading.html --zip samples/document-structure.trace.zip && node scripts/build-reading.mjs --data docs/sample/sample.trace.json --out references/sample-reading.html --zip samples/sample.trace.zip
scripts.build: npm run build:examples && npm run build:showcase && npm run build:reader && npm run build:llms
scripts.validate: node scripts/check-format-lock.mjs && node scripts/check-edits.mjs && node scripts/validate-trace.mjs examples/outliners.trace.json && node scripts/validate-trace.mjs examples/document-structure/document-structure.trace.json && node scripts/validate-trace.mjs docs/sample/sample.trace.json && node scripts/validate-trace.mjs examples/tracecite/tracecite.trace.json
scripts.check: npm run validate && npm run build && git diff --exit-code -- references samples
scripts.build:showcase: node examples/tracecite/tracecite.mjs && node scripts/build-reading.mjs --data examples/tracecite/tracecite.trace.json --out index.html --zip samples/tracecite.trace.zip && node scripts/build-reading.mjs --data examples/tracecite/tracecite.trace.json --out demo/index.html
